caption:
You send the estimate. Then it goes quiet.

That silence is a sign the pipeline has no follow-up plan after the quote goes out.

Here's an example of the kind of sequence that replaces it:

Day 0: estimate sent. Confirmation text follows at the same moment.
Day 2: a one-line check-in on scope or price.
Day 5: next open date shared, so waiting has a cost.
Day 10: last question answered, lead moves to long-term nurture.

This is an example workflow. Build the real version around your own quotes.

#ServiceBusiness #HomeServices #LeadFollowUp #ContractorMarketing #SmallBusinessGrowth
rationale: Carousels still lead 2026 B2B saves/depth, and this estimate follow-up sequence is a genuinely unclaimed demonstration distinct from every prior no-show, reactivation, review, day-of-service, and full-pipeline system already shipped.
